text:
Predicates:
Monkeypox(x) ::: x is monkeypox.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
OccurIn(x, y) ::: x can occur in y.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
SymptomOf(x, y) ::: x is a symptom of y.
FeelTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
GetFlu(x) ::: x gets flu.
Premises:
CausedBy(monkeypox, monkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, animals) ∧ OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, humans) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Mammal(humans) ::: Humans are mammals.
Animal(mammals) ::: Mammals are animals.
SymptomOf(fever, monkeypox) ∧ SymptomOf(headache, monkeypox) ∧ SymptomOf(musclePains, monkeypox) ∧ SymptomOf(feelingTired, monkeypox) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
∀x (GetFlu(x) → FeelTired(x)) ::: People feel tired when they get a flu.
Conclusion:
¬∃x GetFlu(x) ::: No one gets flu.
